title: Demo: an agent building a habit tracker needs 4 decisions

questions.question: Where should habit data live in the first version?
questions.implications: This decides whether people need an account. Browser storage keeps version one offline and free to host, but each device keeps its own data.
options: Browser storage on the device, with no accounts.
A small server with SQLite and email sign-in.
A hosted database such as Supabase, with sign-in.

questions.question: Which home screen should the app open to?
questions.implications: This sets the first screen people see and which layout the agent builds and tests first.
options: Today list with a checkbox for each habit.
Weekly grid with a streak count for each habit.
questions.considerB: streaks are visible without opening each habit.

images.alt: Today list with four habits, two checked
Weekly grid of habits with streak counts

questions.question: Should reminders ship in the first version?
questions.implications: Reminders need a notification permission prompt and a service worker. Leaving them out keeps the first release smaller.
options: One daily reminder at a time the person picks.
A separate reminder time for each habit.

questions.question: What should a missed day do to a streak?
questions.implications: This sets the streak rule the tests check and the line under the weekly view.
options: Allow one missed day per week before the streak resets.
